2607.11498.title: See like a Robot: Robot-Centric Pointmaps for Vision-Language-Action Models
2607.11498.paper_summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict robot actions from visual observations and language instructions. These actions are defined in the robot's own 3D coordinate frame, yet most VLAs observe the scene in the camera frame, creating a frame mismatch between where the scene is observed and where actions are defined. The mismatch is benign under a fixed viewpoint, where the policy can memorize a single observation-to-action mapping, but grows harder as large-scale datasets aggregate demonstrations across diverse camera setups and the policy must generalize this mapping across viewpoints. We address this mismatch with robot-centric pointmaps, images whose pixels store the 3D coordinates of scene points in the robot frame. Pointmaps provide robot-frame 3D geometry while preserving the dense H x W grid expected by pretrained 2D VLAs, so they integrate into existing VLAs with minimal architectural change. On RoboCasa, pointmaps improve both pi0.5 and SmolVLA and outperform representative camera-viewpoint and 3D-aware baselines. In real-robot experiments, their advantage over an RGB-only policy widens when the camera is moved to a placement unseen during training.
2607.11498.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言-行動（VLA）模型根據視覺觀察和語言指令預測機器人的行動。這些行動是在機器人自己的三維坐標系中定義的，但大多數VLA在相機框架中觀察場景，這造成了觀察場景的位置和行動定義的位置之間的框架不匹配。在固定視點下，這種不匹配是良性的，因為策略可以記住單一的觀察到行動的映射，但隨著大型數據集在不同相機設置中聚合示範，這種映射的泛化變得更加困難。我們通過以機器人為中心的點圖來解決這種不匹配，這些圖像的像素存儲了場景點在機器人框架中的三維坐標。點圖提供了機器人框架的三維幾何形狀，同時保持預訓練的二維VLA所期望的密集H x W網格，因此它們可以在最小的架構變更下整合到現有的VLA中。在RoboCasa上，點圖改善了pi0.5和SmolVLA的性能，並超越了代表性的相機視點和三維感知基準。在實際機器人實驗中，當相機移動到訓練期間未見的放置位置時，與僅使用RGB的策略相比，其優勢擴大。
